description:
Insolvency openings in France over the last twelve complete months, against the twelve before, with
the monthly series and a split by nature (liquidation, receivership, safeguard).

Scope: the whole country by default, or one department, or one trade. Pass at most one of them.

This counts OPENING judgments only, and it counts judgments, not companies. The current month is
never included: still running, it would read as a collapse.

department.description: French department code. Two digits, 2A and 2B for Corsica, three digits overseas. Omit for the whole country.

trade.description: Trade, read from the words of the activity declared in the gazette. Omit for all trades.

name: get_french_insolvency_barometer

by_department.description: Ranking over the window, largest first. Country scope only.

change_percent.description: Null when the reference is zero: a place with no failure last year did not explode.

page_url.description: The page that shows the same thing to a human.

name.description: In French: a published value, not a label.

title: French insolvency barometer
